name: Scene
description: Root-capable leaf that produces one scene by its realization method (authored-composite / authored-continuous / whole-clip-generative / edit-footage / motion-graphics).

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: The one scene to make — subject, spoken line(s), visual direction, duration.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: Realization method: authored-composite / authored-continuous / whole-clip-generative / edit-footage / motion-graphics.

produce: Produce this one scene from its spec, consistent with the storyboard's visual direction. Realize it by the spec's method (authored-composite / authored-continuous / whole-clip-generative / edit-footage / motion-graphics) — render, generate, cut, or animate the clip for exactly this scene, not the whole video.
